lines.text: Elisha warned the king of Israel about the places where the Arameans planned to camp, so he stayed on guard.
After learning Elisha was in Bethel, the king of Aram sent horses, chariots, and a great army by night.
After Elisha prayed, the LORD opened the servant's eyes, and he saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire.
The LORD struck the Arameans with blindness, and Elisha led them to Damascus, where their eyes were opened.
Elisha told the king not to kill them, so the king prepared a great feast and sent them away.
